title: MATH-Perturb: Benchmarking LLMs’ Math Reasoning Abilities against Hard Perturbations

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot chain-of-thought (CoT) performance on original math problems against simple and hard perturbations (MATH-P-Simple and MATH-P-Hard) to determine if models rely on memorized training data patterns rather than true mathematical reasoning.

Measuring the out-of-distribution effect by evaluating the performance drop when models are presented with hard problem perturbations that fundamentally alter the problem formulation from the original training distribution.
